Last Week in AI (Substack): Catching up on five weeks: Huang under investigation, Anthropic and OpenAI priced at $1.4T and $1.25T as spending stalls, Anthropic warns it may be nearing recursive self-improvement, Gemini 4 Carbon

Simon Willison: Anthropic's IPO roadshow video Anthropic kicked off their IPO roadshow yesterday, and their roadshow video has some previously unreleased information about how their business works. The section on "Approach to compute" with co-founder Tom Brown is particularly interesting, describing how Anthropic train and serve Claude across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs. topics.what_happened: AWS machine learning blog: Every generative AI team keeps rebuilding the same components: RAG pipelines, document processors, and agent scaffolding. topics.title: Automating AWS Agent Registry updates with push-based architecture
topics.what_happened: AWS machine learning blog: This post shows how to keep the AWS Agent Registry current automatically. Using AWS CloudTrail, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AgentCore Identity, an event-driven pipeline detects MCP server changes and pushes updated tool metadata to the registry with no stored secrets, across single- and multi-account environments.
